title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide adequate iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports fetal development. In this article, we'll introduce three recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, enhancing iron absorption and providing sufficient folate for pregnant women.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Broccoli Bowl with Lemon
* 100g grilled chicken (iron: 1.5mg)
* 100g steamed broccoli (iron: 2.5mg, vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 lemon (vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 cup cooked white rice (folate: 10mcg)

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of heme iron, while steamed broccoli provides non-heme iron and vitamin C. Lemon juice enhances iron absorption. Note: Cook chicken and broccoli thoroughly to ensure food safety.

## Recipe 2: Baked Salmon and Bell Pepper Bowl with Brown Rice
* 100g baked salmon (iron: 1.2mg)
* 100g roasted bell pepper (iron: 2.2mg, vitamin C: 100mg)
* 1 cup cooked brown rice (folate: 10mcg)

Baked salmon is a good source of heme iron, while roasted bell pepper provides non-heme iron and vitamin C. Note: Choose salmon from a safe source and cook it thoroughly to avoid bacterial contamination.

## Recipe 3: Beef and Spinach Stir-Fry Bowl with Cherry Tomatoes
* 100g beef stir-fry (iron: 2.5mg)
* 100g spinach stir-fry (iron: 2.5mg, vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 cup cherry tomatoes (vitamin C: 25mg)
* 1 cup cooked white rice (folate: 10mcg)

Beef stir-fry is an excellent source of heme iron, while spinach stir-fry provides non-heme iron and vitamin C. Cherry tomatoes enhance iron absorption. Note: Cook beef and spinach thoroughly to ensure food safety.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's crucial to follow food safety guidelines:
* Cook meat, fish, and eggs thoroughly to avoid bacterial contamination
* Avoid eating raw or undercooked food
* Wash fruits and vegetables before consumption
* Avoid eating food with preservatives or additives

## Conclusion
These three recipes help pregnant women provide adequate iron and folate for their bodies. Remember to follow food safety guidelines and cook food thoroughly to ensure the health of both mother and baby.
